learning_objective: 🎯 To discover the secret signs of life and learn what makes a jumping frog, a growing tree, and YOU completely different from a non-living rock!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: How do we know something is alive? All living creatures, from tiny ants to giant elephants, share special features. They grow, need food for energy, breathe, and produce young ones!

Have you ever touched a hot pan and quickly pulled your hand away? That sudden change you reacted to is called a stimulus! All living things, even plants turning toward the sun, respond to their surroundings.
Breathing air in and out is just the first step. Inside our bodies, that air is used to unlock energy from our food in a magical process called respiration, keeping our inner engines running!

fun_activity.title: 🔍 The Living vs. Non-Living Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Find one living thing (like a plant or pet) and one non-living thing (like a toy) in your house. Write down three reasons why one is alive and the other is not!

quick_recap: ⭐ Living organisms need food, water, and air to survive and grow.
⭐ Every living creature responds to changes in its environment, known as stimuli.
⭐ Reproduction ensures that plants and animals can create new life of their own kind.
